data.name: Gerrit
data.gender_notes: Gerrit is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Gerrit is recorded in name-lists as “Power, strength, ruler”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gerrit expresses “Power, strength, ruler”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gerrit total 41, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: גרשתי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who drives away or banishes.

in_greek.name: Γεραστος
in_greek.long_meaning: A name borne by several figures in the Old and New Testaments, including Gerasenes, a region on the eastern shore of the Sea of Galilee, and Gerasene demon-possessed man, whom Jesus healed.

in_latin.name: Gerasimus
in_latin.long_meaning: A variant of Gerasenes, a region on the eastern shore of the Sea of Galilee.

biblical_reference.note: The region of Gerasenes is mentioned in the New Testament as the site of the healing of the Gerasene demon-possessed man by Jesus.
